title: St Francis's final Tau

tellings.quote: aisi seeing what was probably a craft or an orb a seraphim and um the last thing he writes in his diary is the Greek letter Tao which uh means conversion

plain: The medieval saint Francis of Assisi is said to have seen a seraph, a fiery angel, which Michels suggests was probably a craft or an orb, and the last thing he wrote in his diary was the Greek letter Tau, which Michels says means conversion. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in a conversation about angels and UFOs in the Bible, as an example of an old religious vision that might describe the same thing people now call UFOs.
